changes.title: Tar pits
items: On the sea chart, the cold rainforest's lakes are tar pits now: glossy black, oil-slick rainbows drifting over them, slow bubbles popping and old bones by the edge

changes.title: Elders review
items: Five legends are now elders of their kind: the stoat an old dark-brown ermine with a garland, the bear grizzled and mossy with a bell at its throat, the polar bear scarred under a crown of ice, the Komodo dragon crowned with spines, and the red panda grizzled under a wreath
The adult bear has a bigger hump

changes.title: Tree tops
items: Tall trees' tops are no longer cut off flat: the firs, pines and other tall crowns grow to their full points
Tree trunks fade out smoothly at their tops in ground mode, instead of ending in a hard edge
